title: Russian-Style Japanese Bread Casserole
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and Russian flavors, this bread casserole is perfect for a cold winter night. Crunchy bread and savory ingredients come together in a delightful dish.
instructions: Cut the white bread into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the cubed Russian bread and cook until lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and miso paste.
Add the cooked bread, green onions, and shredded mozzarella cheese to the bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with additional cheese if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
